interpretation_limits: The shared controller was trained with all-token activation. Its timing ablations change the deployment distribution. A question-only regression is not proof that semantic prefix writes are necessary, nor proof of recurrent memory damage.

If question-only preserves shared successes and its positive gains with directly native prefix states, prefix adaptation is unnecessary for those successes under this fixed checkpoint and cohort; do not generalize to all hybrid models.
Neither shared latent inputs nor successful timing ablation establish explicit semantic dependency constraints, superiority of a new architecture, or absence of prior work.
These are new source streams within the same executable task family, not a new natural-language domain or independently initialized training replication.
next_if_controls_fail: Preserve artifacts; stop interpretation and fix only the demonstrated runtime/source/policy fidelity failure without cohort replacement or threshold tuning.
next_if_complete: Use all unseen-cohort outcomes to decide whether prefix-update co-design has an empirical motivation beyond query adaptation. If it does not, stop expanding memory-protection machinery. Any explicit semantic-controller training must receive a separate prospective method plan and matched data/parameter/control budget; no automatic training is triggered.
